title: Establishment of Regional Benches of the National Commission

content.scenario: The Central Government, in consultation with the National Commission, decides to establish a regional bench in Mumbai to cater to the growing number of consumer disputes in the western region.
content.outcome: The Central Government may establish a regional bench of the National Commission in Mumbai by notification, allowing for more accessible and efficient dispute resolution for consumers in the region.

user_queries: Can the Central Government establish regional benches of the National Commission?
How can regional benches be established?
What is the purpose of regional benches?
